quests.title: The Five Hearthstones
quests.description: The Heart of Lumeria is awake, but its light only reaches the meadow. Five Hearthstones, scattered across the wide world, could carry it everywhere.

steps.text: Restore the five Hearthstones (in any order)

hints: Each Hearthstone asks for something different: a lost fox family in Misty Pinewood, the coast's dark lighthouse, a shipwreck on an isle, the crystal caves, and an aurora high in the Frostbloom Highlands.
A gentle order that works well: the pinewood, then the lighthouse and the isle, then the caves, and the highlands last. Any order is fine.

quests.title: Return of the Light
quests.description: With all five Hearthstones, the Heart of Lumeria can shine over the whole world. Everyone should be there.

steps.text: Set the Hearthstones in the circle at the Heart Tree
Invite your village friends to the Festival of Light
Light the Great Lantern at the Heart Tree

hints: Talk to each villager and choose "Invite to the festival". There's no rush: the festival waits for you.

quests.title: A Wider Journal
quests.description: Lumeria is bright again. There's still so much to see, and all the time in the world.

steps.text: Read the note left at the Moonlit Sanctuary
Meet the Aurora Stag (it appears only now)
Become best friends with every villager

hints: Everything here is optional. The journal's Collections page shows what's left.
